# Combine Image

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Combines an image.

## Syntax

~~~~text
combineImage(images: <#Variable (Optional)#>, mode: <#Enumeration (WFImageCombineMode)#>, spacing: <#Number (Allows Variables) (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
combineImage(images: imageList, mode: Vertically, spacing: 10)
~~~~
